title: Goldman Sachs Forecasts Gold at $5,600 an Ounce by End of 2028 as Fed Rate Cuts Support Demand
summary: Goldman Sachs expects gold prices to reach $5,600 an ounce by the end of 2028, supported by continued central bank purchases and a recovery in Western investment demand once the US Federal Reserve begins reducing interest rates. The investment bank forecasts gold at $4,650 an ounce by the end of 2027, representing a potential increase of 19% from current spot prices, despite expectations of further monetary tightening and near-term market volatility.
